root_cause.text: The `nr_route_frame()` function unconditionally frees the original `skb` buffer after copying it, even if the routing operation subsequently fails (such as when `nr_neigh->ax25` is NULL), which causes the caller to also free the same buffer upon receiving the failure return code.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the immediate `kfree_skb(skb)` call after `skb_copy_expand()` and defers freeing the original socket buffer (`oskb`) by checking `if (ret) kfree_skb(oskb);` at the end of the function. This aligns with the commit message stating that "if nr_neigh->ax25 is NULL, the caller function will free old_skb again, causing a double-free bug."
